content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing an issue with [company_name] GSM 4.2 and [product_name]. I've worked extensively with [product_name], and now I'm trying to use it with the [company_name] GSM modem. Everything seems to function properly: AT commands are accepted, alarm inputs work, and I can send AT commands via SMS to control outputs. The modem sends me SMS notifications when something happens on either [product_name] inputs or modem inputs, and both input and output functions are operational. [product_name] operates fine independently or with the modem, but the modem only responds when [product_name] inputs change. (The outputs from [product_name] and modem's inputs are not physically connected.) For monitoring [product_name] digital inputs, outputs, and flags, I have configured the software parameters accordingly. My main issue is with monitoring the digital outputs (e.g. Q1, Q2), digital flags (e.g. M1, M2), and analog outputs and flags on [product_name]; the modem only sends SMS notifications regarding inputs. The manuals and software indicate these values should be monitorable, but I'm unsure how to achieve this or if it is possible with the modem. Any advice would be appreciated, as I'm new to these modems. Thank you for your response. Best regards, [user_name]. Here are my current GSM 4.2 settings.

I've resolved the issue. The newer [product_name] with [article_no] is not supported by the current HSComm [version_no] (software for the [company_name] GSM modem). The previous [product_name] with [article_no] works very well with the modem and this software version. Support for the latest [product_name] and GSM modem is expected in an upcoming software release.

analysis.insight_summary: The user ran into compatibility issues when connecting a [company_name] GSM modem with the newer [product_name] hardware. Monitoring digital outputs and flags via SMS was not possible due to the modem software lacking support for the latest [product_name] version. Older hardware versions worked as expected, pinpointing the problem to software support for new hardware revisions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants full SMS-based monitoring of all digital and analog outputs and flags from [product_name] through the [company_name] GSM modem, not just inputs, in line with what is described in product documentation.
